description: Search the free amigurumi (crochet toy) patterns on amigurumi.ai. Every pattern has a 3D model and exact round-by-round instructions. Use it when the user wants a crochet toy, plushie or amigurumi pattern or idea, optionally by size, difficulty, no-sew construction, category or yarn colour. Shows the toys as cards.

colours.description: Yarn colours the toy must have.

lang.description: The language of the user's conversation: 'ru' for Russian, else 'en'.

maxDifficulty.description: 1 = beginner, 2 = easy, 3 = intermediate. Use 1 for "for beginners".

maxHeightCm.description: Only toys at most this tall, in cm.

noSew.description: Only no-sew toys: ears, limbs and tails are crocheted into the body, nothing to sew on.

query.description: Words to match: an animal, character, food or colour ("frog", "pink bunny", "dragon"). Leave out to browse.

size.description: Finished height: small < 10 cm, medium 10–20 cm, large > 20 cm.

time.description: How long it takes: evening ≤ 4 h, weekend ≤ 9 h, week longer.

name: search_toys
title: Find amigurumi patterns
